title: Major issue and unrelated 'major' references
summary: This topic is loosely clustered around mentions of "major," with a few concrete complaints about serious faults or shutdowns and many unrelated or too-vague fragments that do not form a single coherent issue.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe major faults, a serious software-update-related shutdown in traffic, and a general reference to a major problem.

mixed.summary: The mixed review cites inability to use Bimmercode as a major issue compared with a prior BMW.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly use the word "major" in unrelated contexts or are too incomplete to identify a clear vehicle issue.

limitations: The cluster mixes true issue reports with unrelated uses of the word "major," such as geography, weather, market position, and vague or incomplete text.
One negative example says the customer had never experienced major issues, which conflicts with the topic label and weakens thematic coherence.
Several fragments are too short or context-free to determine the underlying subject with confidence.
